_comment: Pre-registered before any PathProx score was joined to a test variant. benchmark.ts reads this file and grades mechanically; editing it after results exist invalidates the decision record (doc/HOTSPOT_3D_DECISION.md quotes its sha256).
disclosure: Before registration, scripts/hotspot_probe/ripley_probe.py computed only the two clustering p-values for SOD1 and VHL (both clustered). No discrimination statistic for any gene had been computed.
question: Does the 3D spatial-proximity reading of Sivley et al. 2018 (PathProx), computed on the AlphaFold DB model the app shows, separate germline ClinVar P/LP missense from gnomAD missense well enough, and beyond the regional O/E the app already shows, to appear on the Hotspots subtab as a labelled, non-voting suggestion?

excluded_a_priori.RYR2: AlphaFold DB serves no model for proteins over 2,700 residues (Q92736 returns none), so the app has no model to compute on either.

structure.source: AlphaFold DB, latest model of the UniProt canonical entry (F1), file sha256 recorded in data/
structure.residues: Cα atoms with pLDDT >= 70 (AlphaFold DB's published 'confident' band). Variants at other residues are unscored and reported as coverage.
structure.identity: The model sequence must equal the MANE Select protein residue for residue; otherwise the gene is excluded and the reason recorded.

reference_sets.P: residues with >=1 ClinVar P/LP missense, >=1 star (the app's classifyClinvar rule)
reference_sets.N: residues with >=1 gnomAD v4.1 missense SNV counted by the tolerance benchmark's rule, excluding ClinVar P/LP and conflicting variants
reference_sets.overlap: a residue may be in both sets (Sivley 2018 counts variants, not residues)

clustering_gate.method: Sivley 2018: univariate K of P against random residue sets of the structure; bivariate D(t) = K_P(t) - K_N(t) against label permutations of the pooled P+N positions
clustering_gate.range: minimum observed pairwise distance to half the maximum (to the maximum when the minimum exceeds half of it); P pairs for univariate, pooled pairs for bivariate
clustering_gate.statistic: Simpson area between the observed curve and the median permuted curve
clustering_gate.clustered: both tests p < 0.05 with a positive observed area
clustering_gate.deviations_from_paper: 2,000 permutations instead of 100,000; a single protein, so the paper's 10% FDR across proteins does not apply; AlphaFold model instead of a solved structure; residues instead of variants

score.method: PathProx: proportion of P within t of the residue minus proportion of N within t of the residue
score.threshold_t: the grid distance where the bivariate Z-score (observed minus permutation mean, over permutation SD) is largest, chosen on the full sets as the paper does
score.leave_out: the scored residue's own entries are removed from P and N before scoring (residue-level leave-one-out)

contrasts.plp_vs_gnomad_ac2: ClinVar P/LP missense (>=1 star) vs gnomAD v4.1 missense, joint AC>=2, not ClinVar P/LP or conflicting (tolerance benchmark definition)
contrasts.plp_vs_blb: ClinVar P/LP vs ClinVar B/LB missense (>=1 star)

rmc_oe.label: gnomAD v4.1.1 regional missense O/E at the residue (already on the Landscape tab)

informative_gene.rule: clustering gate passed, and >=10 scored positives and >=10 scored negatives in the primary contrast

P3_discrimination.rule: primary-contrast AUROC >=0.70 with bootstrap 95% CI lower bound >=0.60 in >=2 informative genes (the house standard set by the tolerance benchmark)

P5_incremental.rule: in >=1 informative gene, the paired bootstrap 95% CI of AUROC(PathProx) - AUROC(RMC O/E) lies above 0

decision_rule: Show PathProx on the Hotspots subtab as 'Published method, benchmarked here', non-voting and never an engine input, only if P3 and P5 pass; at run time show it only for a gene whose clustering gate passes. Otherwise reject and record.
